result.title: Read Before You Fit: Text-Derived Constraints for Discovering Differential Equations from Noisy Biological Data
result.summary: Large language models are increasingly used for scientific equation discovery. However, most existing methods are strongly data-driven and assume sufficiently clean and representative observations. This assumption is problematic in biological systems, where individual-level measurements are often sparse, noisy, heterogeneous, and expensive to obtain. While the underlying mechanisms are extensively described in scientific text, they are not explicitly used for the LLM based modeling of such systems. We introduce P2C, an agentic framework that translates textual descriptions of biological systems into a typed set of formal constraints, and use these constraints to restrict candidate ordinary differential equation (ODE) structures before numerical fitting. P2C consists of five stages: Text2Constraint extraction, ODE discovery, symbolic verification, parameter fitting, and model scoring. We evaluate P2C on four published ODE systems of acute inflammation and immune regulation, under clean and noisy observations. By progressively degrading the numerical evidence, we isolate when textual domain knowledge contributes beyond regression alone. Across the four systems, adding Text2Constraint reduces the worst form error from 1.397 to 0.499 on clean data and from 13.096 to 1.095 for data perturbed with Gaussian noise of $σ=0.1$; P2C also achieves lower form error and trajectory error than several LLM-based baselines over the tested noise range.

AI.brief_summary: P2C 将生物系统的文本描述转换为带类型的显式形式约束，在数值拟合前裁剪候选 ODE 结构，并组成 Text2Constraint、发现、符号验证、参数拟合与模型评分的五阶段框架，在干净与加噪观测下检验文本知识相对纯回归的增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 「用文本先验生成显式约束以限制假设空间、再作符号验证」的流程，可能与 LVR 中约束并筛选 latent 假设或推理轨迹、验证候选证据的问题表述相通，但领域距离较远，仅为概念层面的借鉴线索，需核查其约束形式是否可迁移。
